universe: All archived USDT spot histories, including ended histories; no current exchangeInfo or future survival filter. Inherited stablecoin, fiat, leveraged-token and BTC exclusions; 240 consecutive bars since gap/known identity reset, positive D volume, trailing30 quote volume >=1m USDT. No top-N filter. Not all Binance products, nor certified complete historical listings.
labels: Every eligible daily D: high reaches 2x/3x D close during D+1..D+90/180; first passage calendar time; worst low through passage day (conservative intraday ambiguity); worst full-horizon low for failures. A missing bar/known identity boundary terminates the path with zero recovery, preserving prior hits. Also record D+2-open targets, fixed 15% signal-close stop precedence, adverse excursion and end return. No future label enters signal code.
maturity: Require D+181 < era end for inference and entries, including 180 complete D+2-entry bars. Raw atlas includes only D+181 < global end and explicitly flags boundary-purged rows. No recently censored successes are admitted. Matured but ended markets remain failures unless target already hit.
common_price_rule: Completed Sunday: BTC close>SMA200; asset close>SMA50; 0<=r28<=0.30; r7<=0.15. rN=close[D]/close[D-N]-1. No future-priced rankings.

hypotheses.demand: Common rule AND mean quote-volume D-6..D / mean D-34..D-7 >=1.5 AND r28 minus BTC r28 >0. Rank relative28 +0.02*min(volume_ratio,3).
hypotheses.compression: Common rule AND mean true range D-13..D / mean TR D-69..D-14 <=0.70 AND close[D] > maximum HIGH D-20..D-1 AND r90 minus BTC r90 >0. Rank relative90 +0.1*(1-TR_ratio).
hypotheses.price_control: Common price rule only; rank r28. Identical universe, episode rule, execution, sizing and exits. This control uses prices for signals; common historical liquidity screens remain.

episodes: Per strategy/symbol accept the first qualifying Sunday, then suppress all signals for the next181 calendar days, even if entry fails or capacity is full. Reset at each era. At most one position per symbol, no adds. Repeated fills belong to one campaign. Inference also uses a separate outcome-blind risk set: first eligible Sunday per symbol per era, then >=182 days apart; no overlapping 180-day outcome windows.
matching: For each successful 180d2x inference anchor, match up to3 failures on the exact same date from the full eligible daily atlas, same trailing30 liquidity bin [1,3,10,30,100,infinity]m and consecutive-history bin [240,365,730,infinity]. Nearest abs(log liquidity ratio)+abs(log age ratio), symbol tie-break; no replacement per date. Unmatched successes retained in coverage. Match on outcomes only for descriptive case-control research; never trade these hindsight controls. Prevalence, conditional rates, FPR and false-discovery rates come from the unselected inference risk set, not matched case-control prevalence.
execution: Inherited cashflow_alpha.run and portfolio.Book unchanged. Weekly D-close plans observed D+1; earliest D+2 open. Initial stop=0.85*signal close. Stop first if target and stop both touched; worse opening gap. Entry rejected above103% or below90% of signal close by inherited broker. Missing held daily candle or known identity boundary: full cost writeoff; no hindsight last-price exit.
exits: Weekly management: time exit when (D+1-entry_open)/DAY>=168 (actual exit <=175 days after entry); otherwise no trend exit. Stop never loosens. Once D close>=1.5*original fill, tighten to0.70*maximum HIGH of last20 completed bars. Half profit at 6.666666666666667 initial R through inherited broker (approximately2x entry; exact target uses fill and initial stop). End-of-account liquidation uses last close and costs. No adds.
accounts: Each of three rules: base and stress continuous2019..2026-09 plus three independent era accounts. Era labels/entries purged181 days before each end. Continuous account is not a splice of resets. Additional continuous zero-cost D+2 and stress D+3 diagnostics; no selection or tuning from them.
uncertainty: 2000 seeded resamples20261025. Six-calendar-month cluster bootstrap for rates (all assets in block together), separate symbol cluster bootstrap; report union of percentile intervals, point estimates and cluster counts. Paired circular6-month block bootstrap for account mean-return difference vs price control. Trade expectancy/PF resample six-month entry cohorts, retaining whole campaigns; no independent-fill standard errors. Historical intervals are not forecasts, independence proofs or calibrated trade probabilities.
research_edge: Both validation and challenge stress return>0, PF>1.30, expectancy>0 and paired mean-monthly return advantage vs price control with 97.5% two-sided interval lower>0 (two-hypothesis conservative correction); each era >=30 closed campaigns. Rate association alone is exploratory and cannot pass research-edge gate.
live_eligibility: Never approved by this retrospective study. At most candidate for separately authorized forward paper if research edge passes, all audits pass, no halt, every stress account MDD>=-15%, positive monthly fraction>=0.55, mean monthly return>=1%, and fixed20m KRW >=5m target hit in at least50% of full months. Otherwise REJECT on measured failure, NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE if only insufficiency/audit gap. No leverage workaround.
krw: Constant FX scaling, initial10000 virtual USDT corresponds to20m KRW; before FX/tax. Monthly mark-to-market PnL in original compounding account, fixed20m monthly-return equivalent and realized PnL reported separately. Targets5m/10m, idle months included, no withdrawals or salary claims.
fundamentals: Demand/users, fees, protocol revenue, tokenholder revenue, burns, unlocks/supply, governance and inflows surveyed with URLs and access dates. No vintage/first-public-availability proof means QUALITATIVE_ONLY, excluded from historical features. Current revised chart date is not publication timestamp.
parameter_search: Zero empirical parameter trials planned. Two human-selected hypotheses and one price control specified before any v3 outcomes, informed by already-inspected prior research. Preserve all results and implementation corrections. No post-result rule edits; bug repairs require append-only disclosure and fresh execution.
validation: Source checksum/derived-row audit; synthetic boundary/gap/stop/chronology tests; separate validator recomputes atlas labels and signal predicates, reconstructs daily source-marked ledger and risk, reruns continuous accounts and physically deletes future2023+ for prefix invariance. Same-author separate process is not an external investment audit.
